تناءيت (form VI)
# تَنَاءَيْتُ (tanāʔaytu) /ta.naː.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاءَى (tanāʔā)
# تَنَاءَيْتَ (tanāʔayta) /ta.naː.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاءَى (tanāʔā)
# تَنَاءَيْتِ (tanāʔayti) /ta.naː.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاءَى (tanāʔā)
